settings.title: Settings
settings.apiKeysIntro: Create keys to call Yasha's OpenAI-compatible API (/v1) from your own scripts and apps.
settings.newKeyWarning: Copy this key now — it will not be shown again.
settings.revokeConfirmBody: Requests using this key will stop working. This cannot be undone.
settings.errorLimit: You already have 20 active keys. Revoke one first.
settings.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
settings.titleTaskIntro: Model & scheduling for auto-generated chat titles.
settings.titleTaskNeverWarning: Threads keep their placeholder title until set manually.
settings.apiLimitsIntro: Time-to-first-token guard for requests sent to /v1/chat/completions with an API key. These calls reach Lemonade through Yasha.
settings.apiLimitsHint: Applies only to API-key traffic through Yasha's public API — not to interactive chats (Lemonade tab → Chat limits), not to background jobs, and not to the calls Yasha itself makes to Lemonade.
settings.registrationDesc: Public sign-up (/register and the auth API). Existing users can still sign in when disabled.
settings.chatLimitsIntro: History window and first-token timeout for interactive chats.

task.timeoutHint: Max wall-clock time for a single job attempt (the whole generation) before it is retried — not a time-to-first-token limit.

jobs.title: Queue monitor
jobs.intro: Recent background jobs. Refreshes every 5 seconds.
jobs.runtimeIntro: Tune the background-job worker. Empty fields keep the default shown in grey.
jobs.empty: No jobs match the current filters.

memory.title: My memories
memory.intro: Long-term facts and preferences the assistant can recall in new conversations.
memory.optOut: Extract memories from my conversations (when off, I opt out personally)
memory.adminEnableIntro: Instance kill-switch for memory derivation and recall. Users can still opt out individually.
memory.instanceDisabledNotice: Long-term memory is currently disabled by the administrators: no new memories will be extracted or recalled. Your existing memories are kept.
memory.taskIntro: Derive durable facts and preferences from conversations after each exchange.
memory.taskImpact: With “never”, no new memories are ever extracted; “My memories” and recall keep working on existing rows.
memory.taskSummaryIntro: Rolls history older than the chat window into a per-thread summary injected at recall. Default: after 30 min idle.
memory.taskSummaryImpact: Long threads lose their earlier context: no summary is kept beyond the chat window.
memory.taskDreamIntro: Consolidates each user's memories (merge duplicates, narrate contradictions as dated evolution — clear corrections retire the stale entry; pinned and explicit entries untouched), derives new insights from repeated patterns and raw conversation evidence, and rebuilds their typed profile card. Default: 04:00 daily.
memory.taskDreamImpact: Memories are never consolidated: duplicates and stale facts accumulate and the profile card is never built.
memory.tuningIntro: How much of the memory system rides along on each request, and how much history background jobs feed to the model. Defaults suit a typical laptop-sized deployment.
memory.tuningRecallBudgetHint: Maximum size of the memories block injected into every chat turn. Higher = richer personalization, more tokens per request.
memory.tuningTopKHint: Past this many stored memories, only the K most relevant (pinned, then matched, then recent) are injected instead of all.
memory.tuningMsgTruncHint: Each chat message is cut to this length before being sent to the extraction/summary jobs. Keeps one huge paste from crowding out the rest of the transcript.
memory.tuningTranscriptCapHint: Total size limit of the history assembled for each background memory job. Higher = smarter jobs, slower and pricier runs.
memory.tuningDreamDeadlineHint: Wall-clock budget for one user's nightly dream. The job loops over the memory store until this deadline, so a big store simply takes more nights to sweep. Default 40 minutes.
memory.tuningDreamChunkHint: How many memories one consolidation pass feeds the model. Smaller = more passes over several nights but never overflows a small local context window.
memory.tuningDreamInsightsHint: Maximum number of new inferences the dreamer may create per user per night. 0 disables insight extraction (consolidation keeps running).
memory.tuningDreamCardRebuildHint: Every Nth card update, the previous card is withheld and rebuilt from scratch out of the current memories — this flushes anything the incremental updates kept too long.

settings.chatFirstTokenTimeoutHint: Applies to interactive chat turns sent to Lemonade: the upstream request is cancelled if the first token takes longer. Background jobs and API-key requests have their own timeouts.
settings.apiMaxTokensHint: Generation-length limits for API-key traffic on /v1/chat/completions: used when the client omits max_tokens (default) or asks for more than allowed (cap, silently clamped). Raise the cap for long code generations on capable hardware.
settings.chatAttachmentsHint: Image limits for chats: how many you can attach to one message, how many recent images are re-sent to the model on each turn (older ones become text-only), and the accepted upload size before downscaling.
settings.usersIntro: Manage accounts: rename, change email or reset a password.
settings.accountIntro: Update your username, email or password.
settings.usersPasswordHint: Leave empty to keep the current password (8 characters minimum).
settings.passwordChangedRevokeHint: Password updated. For safety, disconnect your other sessions.
settings.sessionsIntro: Devices signed in to your account, most recently used first. Revoke anything you don't recognize.

usersErrors.invalid_username: Invalid username (3-30 letters, digits, dots, dashes, underscores).
usersErrors.email_taken: This email is already used by another account.
usersErrors.no_credential_account: This account has no password to reset.

settings.toolsPrefIntro: Let the assistant use external tools (web search) during conversations.
settings.userMcpDesc: Add your own MCP servers (remote URL). Only you can use them; the assistant can call their tools in conversations.
settings.userMcpError: Could not load your MCP servers. Try again.
settings.userMcpQuota: Server limit reached for your account.
settings.userMcpHeadersHint: Static headers sent with every request (e.g. Authorization). Saved values are never shown again — leave a field empty to keep it, type to replace, Remove to delete.
settings.audioDesc: Voice messages go straight to the audio-capable fast model (Gemma 4) — no transcription service, no read-aloud.
settings.audioDisabledWithModel: Disabled — the fast model ({model}) cannot receive audio.
settings.audioCompatList: Compatible models: {models}. Pick one as the fast model above.
settings.audioSmartNeverNote: Audio input always uses the fast model — the smart model is never used for audio input.
settings.audioSmartIgnored: Your smart model does support audio, but it is ignored for voice on purpose.
settings.audioCaptionTaskIntro: Background verbatim transcription of voice messages by the audio-capable fast model, shown under each audio clip.
settings.audioCaptionTaskNeverWarning: With “never”, voice messages keep no caption (audio stays skimmable only by listening).

geminiImport.title: Import from Gemini
geminiImport.intro: Bring your existing Gemini conversations into Yasha. Google Takeout is unreliable for Gemini, so the recommended path is a browser userscript that exports your chats to a .ndjson file you upload here. On a self-hosted instance the file stays on this server and is deleted after the import.
geminiImport.scriptHintEnd: userscript on gemini.google.com, then upload the downloaded gemini_chats.ndjson file below.
geminiImport.learnHint: Off by default: with thousands of chats, background memory extraction can mean a lot of model work. You can turn it on after a first look.
geminiImport.cancelledNote: Chats imported before the cancel are kept; uploading the file again later only adds what is missing.
geminiImport.datesNote: Imported chats carry no original dates — they are ordered by their position in the export file.
geminiImport.suspectNote: From line {start}: a run of {length} identical conversations — the exporter likely lost the page context there. Re-run it while scrolling through those chats, then upload again; only the missing parts are added.
geminiImport.errNotNdjson: This file does not look like a Gemini NDJSON export.
geminiImport.errTooLarge: The file is too large for this instance.
geminiImport.errInProgress: An import is already running — wait for it or cancel it first.

docs.title: API documentation
docs.intro: Yasha exposes an OpenAI-compatible API. Authenticate with an API key created in Settings.
docs.originNote: Derived from this request ({origin}); behind a proxy it follows your access URL automatically.
docs.pythonInstall: Install the SDK first: pip install openai
docs.realtimeIntro: Optional OpenAI Realtime-compatible WebSocket at /v1/realtime for live interim transcripts (whisper models only). Available when the admin has configured a realtime-capable whisper model and the relay is up; otherwise use the push-to-talk endpoints above.
docs.audioIntro: Voice messages (session-auth): recorded on-device, sent natively to the audio-capable fast model.
